Travel storytelling app

Carnet de Voyage

Tell the story of your travels, step by step.

Who is it for?

Travelers who want to preserve and share their memories.

The problem to solve

Photos, trip stages and anecdotes get scattered and the travel story gets lost.

What the project offers

  • 01Library of travel journals
  • 02Destination, dates and cover
  • 03Journal with text, photos and trip stages
  • 04Story overview and sharing link

The story behind it

My AfriQuest25 journal started in Notion. I turned it into a Lovable app to compose and share my stories more simply.

Available to test

Where does it stand?

Updated: 1 November 2026

App still available to test, currently free.
